newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds steady, waiting for U.S. leads.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds steady, waiting for U.S. leads.

text.p: Austrian bonds finished barely moved after trading in a tight range for most of Wednesday, traders widely expect market to continue treading water for the next few days. New impulses expected from U.S. inflation and jobless data out later this week.
* 10-year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 steady at 99.70 to yield 5.79 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.50/58 to yield 5.81/80 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 steady at 99.50 to yield 4.74 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.45/55 to yield 4.75/73 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 20 bps at 108.28 on turnover of only 64 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at two bps, five-year spread steady at 16 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.400 and overnight money at 3.10/3.35. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
